components.name: Living root gateway
components.function: Existing GEN-08/23 tree/charm vocabulary needs identity matching before reuse. Need root gateway floor/seats, trunk-window reveal and branch-balcony contact/guard geometry where unseen. Low shade planting, blossom petals and occasional deer/butterflies; no replacement by ordinary 18m forest oak. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated living root gateway matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
